entry.title: Asics boosts inventory management using warehouse drones
entry.summary: By using the technology, the footwear brand improved misplaced inventory recovery while slashing manual labor hours and increasing counting frequency.

entry.title: Toy sales aren’t just about kids anymore
entry.summary: U.S. dollar sales for the industry segment grew 20% in the first nine months of the year, driven by collectibles and fandom purchases.

entry.title: J. Crew introduces AI-powered Style Advisor
entry.summary: The desktop digital assistant, developed in partnership with Anthropic, goes beyond individual product searches to deliver a styling experience.

entry.title: Dillard’s grabs some market share again despite weak sales growth
entry.summary: In Q3 the department store eked out 1% increases in retail sales and comps compared to last year, but that beat expectations.

entry.title: Battling turnaround fatigue, Nike teases innovation pipeline
entry.summary: A slate of upcoming products includes a revamp of the activewear giant’s training category and a new manufacturing process for its Air franchise.

entry.title: This year, every day is Black Friday
entry.summary: Deal-hunting consumers have already started their holiday shopping and also plan to shop late. Yet the day itself remains imperative.

entry.title: Target’s Black Friday sale includes in-store gift card giveaway
entry.summary: The mass retailer is aiming to provide value to budget-conscious shoppers and will give early deal access to paid membership customers.

entry.title: Home Depot names longtime company vet as CEO
entry.summary: CFO Richard McPhail, who started at the retailer in 2005, will take the chief executive role, and 40-plus-year vet Ann-Marie Campbell will be COO.

entry.title: Nike won’t return to growth for 3 more years
entry.summary: The activewear giant outlined a plan to grow revenue by $5 billion between fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2031, but it starts with two more years of declines.

entry.title: How brands can welcome AI users onto their sites this holiday season
entry.summary: Customers are experimenting with AI, but the experience needs to feel easy and encourage customers to complete their purchase.
